routes.description: List of HTTP routes to evaluate for authorization coverage. Populated from the cartographer's go-index.json entrypoints.

router.description: Router framework that registered this route (e.g. gin, chi, net/http).

method.description: HTTP method (e.g. GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH).

fqn.description: Fully-qualified name of the handler function (e.g. github.com/example/pkg.HandleFoo).

file.description: Workspace-relative path to the handler source file.

line.description: 1-based line number of the handler function declaration.

first_param_read_line.description: 1-based line number of the first HTTP parameter read in the handler body (used for taint entry tracing).

first_param_read_expr.description: Expression text of the first HTTP parameter read (e.g. c.Query("id")).

middleware_chain.description: List of middleware applied to this route, in order of execution.

authz_primitives.description: Known authorization primitives discovered by the cartographer (e.g. middleware functions, role-check calls).

fqn.description: Fully-qualified name of the authz primitive.

sensitive_operations.description: Sensitive operations (e.g. DB writes, admin actions) that must be protected by authorization.

review_session_id.description: UUID identifying the current security review session.

code_ref.description: Git reference of the code being reviewed.

code_ref_dirty.description: True if the working tree has uncommitted changes at review time.
